Risk Description:
Operational Risk: Aging infrastructure
and resource dependency may disrupt
generation, affecting revenue and
strategic targets.
Mitigation Measures:
• Accelerated maintenance and restoration
efforts
• Conducting of resource optimization studies
• Restoration of catchment areas
• Expedition of procurement and repairs

Risk Description:
Project Execution Risk: Delays in land
acquisition, approvals, and concessions
threaten timely delivery of strategic
projects.
Mitigation Measures:
• Engagements with MoEP, GDC for access to
renewable energy resources
• Enhanced community engagement
• Fast-tracking of statutory approvals

Risk Description:
Financial Risk: Funding constraints and
overreliance on KPLC limit investment in
diversification and innovation.
Mitigation Measures:
• Diversification of financing sources targeting
DFIs, PPPs, and other innovative financing
mechanisms
• Activation of new revenue streams

Risk Description:
Legal & Regulatory Risk: Delays in
licensing, contracts, and policy changes
impact project execution and investment
decisions.
Mitigation Measures:
• Fast-tracking of legal processes
• Advocating for policy reforms
• Strengthening engagement with regulators

Risk Description:
Human Capital Risk: Skills gaps and weak
succession planning threaten execution
of the transformation strategy.
Mitigation Measures:
• Roll out of succession planning
• Upskill and reskill workforce
• Align HR to strategic needs

Risk Description:
Strategic Alignment Risk: Internal
resistance, competition, and stakeholder
misalignment may affect agility and
strategic delivery.
Mitigation Measures:
• Promotion of innovation and alignment
• Strengthening change management
• Deepening stakeholder engagement

Risk Description:
Technology & Cyber Risk: Cyber threats
and slow tech adoption may hinder
operational efficiency and digital
transformation.
Mitigation Measures:
• Strengthening cybersecurity
• Improvement of data governance
• Building and enhancing digital capabilities
• Embedding ICT into the strategy
